title: Discover
sub: Twenty titles per list that your library does not have yet. One click adds them.

movie.fresh: Movies out on digital or disc in the last four months. Movies only in cinemas are left out.
movie.popular: What is in demand on TMDB right now, but only what is out on digital or disc already.
movie.acclaimed: Out on digital or disc in the last year, by rating, at least 200 votes.
movie.classics: Released before 1996, by rating, at least 1,000 votes.

series.new: Series whose first episode aired in the last four months, by popularity.
series.popular: What is in demand on TMDB right now. News, talk, reality and soaps are left out.
series.ended: Series that have told their story, by rating: good for watching in one go.

album.fresh: Albums and EPs of the last 60 days that are played a lot this week.
album.trending: The albums played most on ListenBrainz this week.
album.classics: The albums played most on ListenBrainz of all time.

filters.label: Filters
filters.regionOff: Classics are out everywhere, no country counts here.

empty: Nothing here that you are missing right now. Try another list or fewer filters.
noMore: TMDB has no more for this choice.
tmdbNeeded: For movies and series, Discover needs access to TMDB of your own. It is free for private use.

music.offText: ListenBrainz is MusicBrainz's open listening record. nexcrate only fetches the lists of the most played albums there, without a key and without telling anything about your library. It is off from the factory; you can switch it off again under Settings, Online services.
music.source: Listening figures from ListenBrainz (MetaBrainz), covers from the Cover Art Archive.
